headline: Palace Suspends Work and Classes in NCR and 11 Provinces From 3 PM
seoTitle: Palace Suspends Work, Classes in NCR and 11 Provinces
seoDescription: Memorandum Circular No. 125 suspended government work and classes in NCR and 11 provinces from 3 p.m. on August 13 because of continued monsoon rain.
deck: Memorandum Circular No. 125 suspended government work and classes in NCR and 11 provinces from 3 p.m. on August 13 because of continued monsoon rain.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang suspended work in government offices and classes at all levels in public and private schools beginning at 3 p.m. Thursday, August 13, under Memorandum Circular No. 125.
The order covered the National Capital Region and the provinces of Zambales, Bataan, Bulacan, Pampanga, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Cavite, Batangas, Rizal, Laguna and Quezon.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Palace issued the suspension because of continued heavy rainfall associated with the Southwest Monsoon and upon the recommendation of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council.

Agencies providing basic and health services, disaster preparedness and response, and other vital services were directed to continue operations. Work suspension in private companies and offices was left to the discretion of their respective heads.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The directive affected government employees, schools, students and families across Metro Manila and a broad part of Luzon. Clearly distinguishing mandatory government and school suspensions from private-employer discretion helps prevent unsafe or unnecessary travel.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The circular applied to Thursday afternoon. Any suspension for Friday, August 14, requires a separate announcement from Malacañang, a local government or the affected institution.
